note.closing: Lunch and dinner shares are for planning. A reference amount is not an upper limit. Total sugar on the menu is not compared with free-sugar or added-sugar advice.
note.efsa.body: DRVs read daily energy from a table for your age, sex and activity. Your weight and height do not change that table.
note.dge_oege.body: estimates daily energy from age, sex, weight and activity from age 19. At 18 it uses an age and sex table instead.
note.ch_blv.body: BLV gives an energy range for your age and sex. Weight, height and activity do not change that table.
note.cn_dri_2023.body: DRIs 2023 look up daily energy by age, sex and activity class. The number comes from a group table, not from your weight and height.
note.us_nasem.body: estimates daily energy from age, sex, height, weight and activity. Activity chooses the equation. It is not multiplied on again afterwards.
note.us_dga_2025.body: 2025–2030 does not include its own energy equation here. Choose another equation, or enter your daily energy. Protein uses your actual weight, and added sugar is limited per meal.
note.who.body: sets limits for fat, salt, fibre and free sugar. It does not define daily energy or one protein number, so choose an energy calculation.
note.dge_sport.body: sport 2020 gives a higher protein range only when you train more than 5 hours a week. It does not estimate energy from those hours.
note.issn.body: gives a daily protein range for healthy people who train, and a choice for how to count protein at each meal. It does not estimate energy.
note.acsm.body: 2016 gives protein, fat and carbohydrate ranges for training. Carbohydrate follows the training load you choose for that day. Energy still needs its own calculation.
note.nice_ng246.body: NG246 plans an energy deficit from your maintenance energy. Enter the deficit from your agreed plan. It does not list targets for the other nutrients.
note.dag_s3_2024.body: S3 obesity guidance plans an energy deficit from maintenance energy. The guideline usually suggests about 500–600 kcal a day; enter the deficit from your agreed plan. Macronutrients can stay individual, or follow a DGE orientation.
note.cn_obesity_2024.body: NHC obesity guidance applies when BMI is at least 24. It lowers maintenance energy by 30–50%. It is not a target for every adult.
